# California Electricity Demand 2020 - 2050

```{r imports}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(fpp3)
library(scales)
```

## General Data Import

```{r datasets into CA tsibble}
energy_data <- read.csv("../data/Energy.csv")

# Aggregate total VALUE by state and year across all subsectors and technologies
ca_energy <- energy_data |>
  group_by(state = "California", year) |>
  summarise(total_value = sum(VALUE, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Convert to a tsibble with 'year' as index and 'state' as the key
ca_ts <- ca_energy |>
  as_tsibble(index = year, key = state)

# Convert total value to TWh and create new "TWh" Column
ca_ts <- ca_ts |>
  mutate(TWh = total_value / 3412142)

# Verify the tsibble structure
ca_ts
```

```{r EDA}

```

```{r ETS Models}

# 1. Create Train and test sets   - REUSABLE -
train <- ca_ts |> filter(year >= 2020, year <= 2044)
test  <- ca_ts |> filter(year >= 2045, year <= 2050)

# 2. Fit ETS models

```

```{r TSLM Models Fit, Forecast, and Plot}

# 1. Create Train and test sets   - REUSABLE -
train <- ca_ts |> filter(year >= 2020, year <= 2044)
test  <- ca_ts |> filter(year >= 2045, year <= 2050)

# 2. Fit both TSLM models
ca_tslm_fit <- train |>
  model(
    linear_tslm = TSLM(TWh ~ trend()),
    log_linear_tslm = TSLM(log(TWh) ~ trend())
  )

# 3. Forecast 2045–2050
ca_fc <- ca_tslm_fit |>
  forecast(new_data = test)

# 4. Test accuracy
ca_fc |>
  accuracy(ca_ts) |>
  select(.model, RMSE, MAE, MAPE) |>
  arrange(RMSE)

# 5. Plot forecasts
ca_fc |>
  autoplot(ca_ts, level = 95) +
  facet_wrap(~ .model, ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "CA Energy Demand: Linear vs Log-linear TSLM",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Total Energy Value in TWh"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
# Rolling-origin cross-validation
ca_cv <- ca_ts |>
  stretch_tsibble(.init = nrow(ca_ts) - 10, .step = 1) |>
  model(
    linear_tslm = TSLM(TWh ~ trend()),
    log_linear_tslm = TSLM(log(TWh) ~ trend())
  ) |>
  forecast(h = 5)

# Compare forecast accuracy
ca_cv |>
  accuracy(ca_ts) |>
  select(.model, RMSE, MAE, MAPE) |>
  arrange(RMSE)
```

```{r TSLM Residuals}
ca_fit |>
  select(log_linear_tslm) |>
  gg_tsresiduals()
```

```{r LB}
ca_fit |>
  augment() |>
  features(.innov, ljung_box, lag = 5, dof = 2)
```
